$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). actorId is added after the first deploy.
seoTitle: Workday Jobs Scraper - Search Every Company
seoDescription: Search every company on Workday at once: job titles, locations, remote work and posting dates. Newest first, read live, no company list and no login.

pricing.$comment: 2026-10-30. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitors for one Workday job with its description: fantastic-jobs/workday-jobs-api $0.002 (181 u30, a database), glitchbound/workday-jobs-scraper $0.002 (123 u30, company names or links). 10% below them with details; a list-only row costs less. No start fee. Start high while private: a cut is free, a raise costs a month. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, location, work type, posting date, job link and requisition number. Also one checked job link that is closed.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, exact date, job type, apply link and every location.

defaultRunOptions$comment: 2 GB: a full keyword pass read all 2,207 sites about twice as fast as at 1 GB for the same or less compute (2026-10-30). Workday also holds a run to about 10 calls a second, so 128 parallel calls did not beat 64.
